scene_description: Black-topped table against a cream wall. A hole punch lies on the open front-left. Along the wall sit a sanitizer pump with a tape dispenser in front of it, a wire letter tray of paper, and a pencil sharpener in the back-right corner. Front is the edge away from the wall.

targets.name: hole punch
targets.description: Black and silver three-hole punch lying diagonally on the open front-left of the table.
targets.clearance_notes: Open table on all sides, well away from the other objects.

targets.name: tape dispenser
targets.description: Black tape dispenser standing directly in front of the hand sanitizer near the back wall.
nearby_obstacles: Hand sanitizer pump directly behind it
targets.clearance_notes: Sides and front are open, but it sits far back from the front edge.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the tape dispenser approximately 20 cm toward the front of the table.

targets.name: hand sanitizer pump
targets.description: Purell hand sanitizer pump bottle standing against the wall, behind the tape dispenser and left of the letter tray.
nearby_obstacles: Letter tray close on its right
targets.clearance_notes: Boxed in by the wall, the tape dispenser and the tray; only the left side is open.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the sanitizer approximately 15 cm left along the wall, clear of the tape dispenser.

targets.name: letter tray of paper
targets.description: Black wire-mesh letter tray holding a stack of printed paper, against the wall between the sanitizer and the pencil sharpener.
nearby_obstacles: Pencil sharpener close on its right
targets.clearance_notes: Front edge is open, but the back is at the wall and both sides have little room.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the tray approximately 15 cm toward the front, keeping it level.

targets.other_notes: Paper may fall out if the tray is tilted.

targets.name: pencil sharpener
targets.description: Black electric pencil sharpener with a clear shavings bin, standing in the back-right corner of the table with its cord running off the right side.
nearby_obstacles: Letter tray close on its left
targets.clearance_notes: Front is open, but it sits against the wall at the right end of the table.

candidate_improvements.description: Unplug the sharpener, then move it approximately 15 cm toward the front.

targets.other_notes: Plugged in; must be unplugged before it is moved.

source: Staged permutation of S0025 and S0027, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
